FORMAT: Ghostnote Document FIELDS

SCOPE

The first line is DOC ghostnote-document 1.0 desired. Envelope records precede the single FIELDS binding: CLIP, COVERAGE and any supplied META, BASE or EXTENSIONS each carry a JSON object. This task compares performed core notes: MIDI pitch, quarter-note onset, positive duration and integer velocity. All inputs use a 1/512-quarter-note grid, a fixed 4/4 display meter, channel 1 and a 64-quarter-note clip. IDs and presentation order are not cross-format-scored; native ID, address and parser constraints still apply. Do not add unsupported state or assume native constraints disappear. Do not infer musical intent from timing. Scoring normalizes proposed performed notes once for every arm: floor onsets to a 1/512-quarter-note cell and round positive durations to the nearest cell, ties upward, with a minimum duration of 1/512. Apply requested arithmetic before realization, without repeatedly quantizing intermediate values.

Performed core-note cohort; fixed 4/4, channel 1, clip length 64 quarter notes.

The complete document is both the input and output grammar; do not return a patch object or an events-only array.

Each note has exactly one of at (direct onset) or spread (derived onset); a binding may include both with - for the absent cell. Derived onset equals the containing group's anchor + delay (default 0) + spread. REF id adds membership without another note definition; forward references are allowed. PRESERVATION
Return all blocks, definitions and references. Shared timing and note rows are colocated. Changing a derived onset requires changing its spread consistently; editing pitch or velocity leaves timing unchanged. Labels and prose do not supply missing numerical timing.

R01-GROUPED-FIELDS 1
NOTES {
  FIELDS id pitch at duration velocity
  NOTE exampleA 62 65/512 3/4 73

Return native notation text, not JSON. v sets integer velocity; n sets duration as a whole-note fraction: n/4 is one quarter note, n3/8 is one and a half quarters. One-based bar|beat positions use fixed 4/4: 1|1 is onset zero and 2|1 is onset four quarters. Positions accept decimal beats or whole-note offsets such as +n1/2048. A position suffix xN emits N total repetitions; @nF supplies whole-note spacing, otherwise spacing is the active duration.
